question: Calculate the percentage change in the total number of unsheltered homeless people from 2015 to 2018 for each state by summing the counts over all Continuums of Care (CoCs) within each state. Then, determine the national average of these state percentage changes. Identify the five states whose percentage change is closest to this national average percentage change. Please provide the state abbreviations.
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(CoC_Number, 1, 2) as state_abbr,
    Count_Year,
    SUM(Unsheltered_Homeless) as total_unsheltered
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
  WHERE Count_Year IN (2015, 2018)
  GROUP BY state_abbr, Count_Year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    state_abbr,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Count_Year = 2015 THEN total_unsheltered END) as count_2015,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Count_Year = 2018 THEN total_unsheltered END) as count_2018
  FROM base
  GROUP BY state_abbr
),
pct AS (
  SELECT 
    state_abbr,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(count_2018 - count_2015 AS FLOAT64), CAST(count_2015 AS FLOAT64)) * 100.0 as pct_change
  FROM pivoted
  WHERE count_2015 IS NOT NULL AND count_2015 > 0
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change FROM pct
),
with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    p.state_abbr,
    p.pct_change,
    a.avg_pct_change,
    ABS(p.pct_change - a.avg_pct_change) as diff
  FROM pct p, avg_calc a
)
SELECT state_abbr
FROM with_diff
ORDER BY diff ASC
LIMIT 5
